Thanks Marissa — yes that recap looks good. Couple clarifications from my side:
- Procurement: our typical procurement review is 7-10 business days for standard MSAs; for any custom pricing or SLA exceptions it can stretch to 3-4 weeks. PO is required for production contracts.
- Legal routing: Michael will own the MSA/DPA review; we typically want the NDA signed first but it can be concurrent with MSA comments.
- Decision criteria: cost per token at scale, latency guarantees (p95), and ability to support a private VPC for PII workloads.

Michael — can you confirm your preferred process/timelines for redlines? If it helps, we can do an initial 30-min sync next Tue (7/21) to prioritize clauses.

Hi all — quick note from legal side. We prefer the following sequencing to avoid repeated rounds:
1) NDA executed (standard, quick turnaround)
2) ACME reviews MSA + DPA and returns a single consolidated redline set to Redwood (we try to avoid piecemeal comments)
3) Redwood responds with a single consolidated counter-redline; if material changes are requested we'll ask for a 1-hour call to resolve.

Turn times: depending on complexity, we aim for 5-8 business days for initial redline review. If Redwood can flag any non-starters up front (SLA exceptions, data residency constraints, indemnity/limitation of liability), that will speed things up.

For the DPA, we require: data processing addendum, subprocessors list, SOC2 audit evidence, and a KMS/HSM controls section. Tom — can you confirm if our security team needs any additional artifacts (e.g., pen test report) before we sign?

Marissa/Vivek/Neha — please send the MSA+DPA package and any SOC2 links or security briefs.

Regards,
Michael Chen
Counsel, ACME Payments

Thanks Michael — looping in the specifics below and attaching the artifacts per the request.

Routing & sequencing (Redwood proposal):
- NDA: we typically route DocuSign to the economic buyer + counsel for signature (1-3 business days).
- MSA: our standard MSA (redwood-msapackage-v1.docx) + DPA included. Prefer to receive a single consolidated redline from ACME.
- Parallel artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and subprocessors list will be provided before MSA signature.

Non-starters / items to flag in advance (to avoid 3-4 week cycles):
- Unlimited indemnity or full-waiver of Redwood's standard liability cap — those will likely be exceptions we need to escalate.
- Data residency requests that require dedicated on-prem deployments — those change pricing and timeline materially.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood-nda-acme.pdf
